$comment: Organizing ideas for a page. A composition decides what the first screen shows and how the sections are paced, so two pages with the same content still differ in structure, not just in color. kinds: where it fits; needs: moods the subject must have (a product interface only for software, one object on a plinth only for a product); signatures: motion that serves it.

compositions.idea: The headline is the hero image: type at --t-mega, set tight, allowed to touch or crop at the viewport edge, with one object overlapping it.
compositions.firstScreen: Two to five words at 13-18vw, one supporting line under 14 words, one action, one object or shape cutting into the letters.
sections: proof strip of 3 facts in one line
pinned manifesto lit word by word
offer told as 3 numbered statements, not cards
closing poster that repeats the action

compositions.idea: A sticky left column of copy while the right half is a stage that changes as you scroll.
compositions.firstScreen: Left: headline and action. Right: the product, object or diagram at full height.
sections: stage scene 1-3 driven by scroll progress, copy on the left changes per scene
specs or facts as a tight table

compositions.idea: The page is an index: large numbered rows (01-08) that name the offer; hovering or focusing a row previews it.
compositions.firstScreen: Name and one line at the top, then the first three rows of the index already visible.
sections: one expanded row told in depth
facts or hours as a ledger

compositions.idea: One object sits in the center of the first screen with labels on leader lines; scrolling turns, opens or explodes it.
compositions.firstScreen: The object at 55-70% of the viewport height, 2-4 short labels around it, headline small above or below.
sections: the object coming apart or turning (scroll-scrubbed)
each part explained in one line

compositions.idea: Content laid out like a ticket, receipt or label: perforations, fields, totals, a stub.
compositions.firstScreen: A ticket or label at center or tilted slightly, with the headline as the event or product name and fields for date, place, price.
sections: program or menu as receipt lines with leaders and prices

compositions.idea: A bento grid where one tile takes two thirds of the area and each tile shows a working micro-demo, never three equal cards.
compositions.firstScreen: Headline and action above a grid: one dominant live tile and 2-4 smaller ones of unequal size.
sections: one tile expanded into a full section

compositions.idea: A pinned section that moves sideways while the page scrolls down: a timeline, a process, a gallery, a route.
compositions.firstScreen: Statement headline and a strip of the first rail items peeking in from the right.
sections: what happens after (one paragraph, one number)

compositions.idea: The story is told as full-height cards that stack on top of each other while scrolling, one chapter per card.
compositions.firstScreen: Headline, one line and the edge of the first chapter card visible at the bottom.
sections: 3-5 chapter cards, each a different color role or image

compositions.idea: Long passages of large text that light up as you read, separated by single huge numbers.
compositions.firstScreen: A short headline and a first sentence already in the scroll-lit treatment.
sections: manifesto passage 1 (pinned, lit word by word)

compositions.idea: The page is organised around a place: coordinates, distances, a drawn map line, opening hours as a ledger.
compositions.firstScreen: The place name as headline, coordinates and the neighborhood in small type, a drawn route or street grid in SVG.

compositions.idea: Like a type or product specimen: variations in a grid with measurements, rulers and annotations.
compositions.firstScreen: The product name, then a row of its variants (origins, colors, sizes) with one measured attribute each.
sections: one variant shown large with annotations

compositions.idea: Bands of moving type separate big static statements; the page has rhythm like a festival flyer.
compositions.firstScreen: A huge static headline between two moving bands of the lineup, dates or menu items.

compositions.idea: A magazine spread on a 12-column grid: asymmetric columns, a pull quote, captions under images, a drop cap.
compositions.firstScreen: Headline spanning 8 columns, a deck in 4, one tall image or drawn plate offset from the grid.

compositions.idea: The hero is the product interface itself, built in HTML with real states, not a screenshot.
compositions.firstScreen: Headline left or above; the interface at 60% width doing its main job with one live state change.
sections: three workflows, each shown as the interface in that state
pricing or plans as a table
